title: perf: every Portfolio Pages build job re-runs the 19 s shed gallery search; its stamp is never cached
problem: portfolio-pages.yml build job step 'Search the Shed Designer gallery with this checkout's prices' runs make-gallery.mjs. The script already skips the search when .gallery-stamp (gitignored) matches the hash of the engine sources and data, but a fresh runner never has the stamp, so every one of 34 build jobs pays the full search (19 s median, 10.3 job-minutes over the 600-run window, 1.7% of the pool). Locally: 25.7 s wall cold, instant on a repeat. The edit is in .github/, which CODEOWNERS holds for the owner.
evidence: python3 platform/ci/ci_profile.py --runs 600 --steps 15, 2026-11-08: Portfolio Pages build, 34 runs, 10.3 min, 19 s median, 'Search the Shed Designer gallery with this checkout's prices'
local: node ventures/shed-designer/make-gallery.mjs 25.7 s real cold; the second run prints 'skipping the search' and exits at once (the stamp)
change: Before the step, actions/cache/restore the stamp keyed on hashFiles('ventures/shed-designer/*.mjs', 'ventures/shed-designer/data/**') (exclude tests and gallery-data.mjs to match inputsHash(), or accept a slightly wider key); the restored stamp plus the checked-out gallery-data.mjs makes the script skip. After a real search on a non-PR run, actions/cache/save the stamp. Safe only if the committed gallery-data.mjs equals the search output for that hash: confirm with make-gallery.mjs --check on main first (gallery.test.mjs already fails when they disagree). Alternative needing no cache: have the PR gate keep gallery-data.mjs current and skip the CI step entirely when --check passes in the test job.
metric: Pages build job 'Search the Shed Designer gallery' seconds (ci_profile.py --steps)
history: 2026-11-09: make-gallery runs its three searches in worker threads, 24.9 s to 13.8 s locally (docs/history/ci-perf-2026-11-09-gallery-search-threads.md); the stamp cache would still save the rest.

2026-11-10: cold search 12.0 s (--check) / 12.5 s (write) locally, gallery-data.mjs unchanged, so the cache safety condition holds on main; row stays open, the workflow edit is owner-gated (docs/history/ci-perf-2026-11-10-gallery-search-reading.md).
